rows.summary: This cycle integrates findings on institutional path dependence with neural spatial representation mechanisms to refine the model of divergent value formation. Evidence from preferential trade agreement networks demonstrates that early design choices structurally limit future institutional pathways, while findings on entorhinal cortex grid-cell representations provide an abstract analogy for how constrained boundary interactions might govern state-space navigation.
